harness.definition:
n. a support consisting of an arrangement of straps for holding something to the body (especially one supporting a person suspended from a parachute)
n. stable gear consisting of an arrangement of leather straps fitted to a draft animal so that it can be attached to and pull a cart
v. put a harness
v. exploit the power of
harness.translation:
n. 马具, 挽具状带子, 甲胄
vt. 给...上挽具, 驾驭, 披上甲胄, 利用...以产生动力

harness horse.translation: 轻驾车赛用马, 轻挽马; 拉车马

harnessed.translation: v. 给（马等）装上挽具( harness的过去式和过去分词 ); 治理, 利用

harnesses.definition:
n a support consisting of an arrangement of straps for holding something to the body (especially one supporting a person suspended from a parachute)
n stable gear consisting of an arrangement of leather straps fitted to a draft animal so that it can be attached to and pull a cart
v put a harness
v exploit the power of
v control and direct with or as if by reins
v keep in check
harnesses.translation: n. 马具( harness的名词复数 ); 挽具; （防止坠落或摔倒的）背带; 保护带

harnessing.definition:
v put a harness
v exploit the power of
v control and direct with or as if by reins
v keep in check
harnessing.translation: v. 给（马等）装上挽具( harness的现在分词 ); 治理, 利用

harnett.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 哈尼特 Arnold的变体

harney.translation: [人名] [爱尔兰姓氏] 哈尼盖尔语姓氏的英语形式，来源于人名，含义是“小牛”(calf); [地名] [美国] 哈尼
